title: INSCRIPCIONES — Torrencial Chile by UTMB 2027 general conditions
publisher: UTMB World Series / Torrencial Chile by UTMB
claims: The event runs from 24 to 27 June 2027 in Valdivia, Chile, with distances of 100k, 65k, 45k, 20k, 12k and 6k.
Runner check-in runs on 24, 25 and 26 June 2027.
Pilolcura 100K entry costs USD 254 for international runners and USD 216 for Chilean runners in period 1, subject to change.
The top three female and top three male runners in the 100K and 50K categories obtain automatic qualification for the CCC and OCC races respectively.
Finishers in the corresponding categories obtain Running Stones that can be used in the UTMB Mont-Blanc lottery.
Registration transfers are allowed until Monday 31 May 2027 for a USD 15 fee, and distance changes until Monday 11 June 2027 for a USD 15 fee.
